description: PAOT 2022-2027 - Actions prévues en Bretagne - Industrie / Pollutions portuaires et nautiques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement de Bretagne. Ensemble des actions des PAOT des quatre départements bretons concernant les actions de type "Industrie / Réduire les pollutions liées aux industries portuaires et activités nautiques" La Directive Cadre sur l’Eau (DCE) du 23 octobre 2000 établit un cadre européen pour la protection des eaux continentales, souterraines et côtières. Coverage: Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement de Bretagne. The portal shows the English title as "PAOT 2022-2027 - Planned actions in Brittany - Industry / Port and nautical pollution" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement de Bretagne. Its keywords include pollution-industrielle, sdage, bretagne, paot, hydrographie, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
